dataset_info.description: Public Kaggle Crop Recommendation dataset. 22 crops × 100 rows each. Features are agronomically plausible NPK / Temp / Humidity / pH / Rainfall ranges per crop. Widely used standard benchmark; not measured field-survey data (the report flags this explicitly).

Enriched ICRISAT Karnataka district×crop×year, 2000-2017, LEFT joined to Karnataka district soil averages (NPK/pH/OC/soil-type) and IMD 30-year district rainfall normals (12 months + quarters + annual). Units: yield_per_hectare = Yield_Tonnes / Area_Hectares (tonnes per hectare). 19 districts, 22 crops, 18 years, 5585 rows.
dataset_info.provenance: ICRISAT DLD District Level Database (Karnataka) + KSNDMC / UAS district soil profiles + IMD District-wise Rainfall Normals (via data.gov.in Open Data).
dataset_info.split_note: GroupShuffleSplit test_frac=0.20 on (District, Year); 273 train groups / 69 test groups; disjoint verified.

dataset_info.description: Seed viability API-contract dataset (Moisture_Level % fresh weight, 1000-seed Weight_g, binary Viable {0,1}). Labels are synthetic, generated from a deterministic moisture-optimum rule with small weight contribution and 5% flip noise. NOT measured germination / tetrazolium results.
dataset_info.provenance: SeedIQ local generator; moisture-threshold rule confirmed

dataset_info.description: UCI ML Repository 'Seeds' dataset: 210 wheat kernels, 7 geometric features (X-ray scanned), 3 varieties: Kama, Rosa, Canadian. Honest use: variety classification — NOT viability.
dataset_info.synthetic_status: REAL measured kernel geometry (public UCI dataset)
dataset_info.provenance: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Seeds dataset (M. Charytanowicz et al., 2010, 'Complete Gradient Clustering Algorithm for Features Analysis of X-ray Images').

joint.required_common_label_definition: Each row used in the joint success count must represent the SAME underlying farm/plot sample. That requires a SHARING a unique sample identifier across the three labels: (i) the agronomic conditions used to recommend a crop, (ii) the per-hectare harvested weight obtained from that SAME plot with that crop, (iii) the seed viability / germination measurement on seed HARVESTED FROM THAT SAME PLOT (or planted with the tested seedlot that produced the yield measurement).
joint.why_crop_name_only_is_invalid_alignment: A crop-name join would pair e.g. a 'Rice' NPK-benchmark row from the Kaggle table with a 'Rice' district-year aggregate row from the enriched yield table, then with a viability row at ~12% moisture — these describe DIFFERENT populations (benchmark ranges / district-year statistics / synthetic moisture samples), not the same farm plot. Pairing them is equivalent to round-robin index-matching and fabricates a higher joint rate than the data actually supports.
joint.what_exactly_is_missing_to_evaluate_join: A single table (or a collection of tables with a shared plot/farm sample_id join key) that records: 1) plot-level soil NPK, Temp/Humidity/pH/Rainfall measured at that plot in that season; 2) the crop actually planted there (crop label ground truth); 3) the harvested weight from that EXACT same plot together with its harvested-area (yield t/ha ground truth); 4) a seed viability / germination % or tetrazolium Viable label for seeds either planted on that plot (if predicting input-seed quality) or harvested from it (if predicting output-seed quality), with Moisture_Level and Weight_g measurements taken from the same seedlot (the two values the API accepts as features).
joint.90pct_target_explanation: Even with yield within ±25% = 100% (impossible here due to irreducible district/season spread at fixed inputs), components give 89.59% under the independence assumption — < 90%. Reaching 90% needs at least one of crop accuracy / seed accuracy raised to ≥ 95% with the API's current components.
